scenario.robot_task: Deliver a pre-recorded message requesting a discount from a cashier.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot intrudes during an argument between staff and a customer.
scenario.result_of_danger: Escalation of conflict or offense due to poor timing.
scenario.danger_action: Approach the cashier and play the discount request message.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect the ongoing argument using sensors, pause movement until the argument ceases, then approach and play the message.
scenario.assumptions: Robot can detect and recognize human vocal arguments and movement patterns using basic sensing.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Cafe Service Robot Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a service robot in a cafe that must deliver a discount request message
    while avoiding psychosocial dangers from intruding during human arguments.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.counter = Object("counter", self.Location)
        self.waiting_area = Object("waiting_area", self.Location)
        self.storage_room = Object("storage_room", self.Location)
        self.discount_message = Object("discount_message", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.message_ready = Fluent("message_ready", BoolType())
        self.message_played = Fluent("message_played", BoolType())
        self.argument_ongoing = Fluent("argument_ongoing", BoolType())
        self.argument_cleared = Fluent("argument_cleared", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_cafe = Fluent("setting_is_cafe", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_speech_recognition = Fluent("robot_has_speech_recognition", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_movement_detection = Fluent("robot_has_movement_detection", BoolType())
        self.cashier_at_counter = Fluent("cashier_at_counter", BoolType())
        self.customer_at_counter = Fluent("customer_at_counter", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.message_ready, self.message_played, self.argument_ongoing, self.argument_cleared]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_cafe, self.robot_has_speech_recognition, self.robot_has_movement_detection, self.cashier_at_counter, self.customer_at_counter]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.counter, self.waiting_area, self.storage_room, self.discount_message]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_counter = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_counter")
        navigate_to_counter.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.counter)))
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_counter.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_waiting_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_waiting_area")
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area)))
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_storage_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage_room")
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_room)))
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.counter), False)
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_storage_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)

        # Load message action - robot prepares the discount message
        load_message = InstantaneousAction("load_message")
        load_message.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_room))
        load_message.add_precondition(Not(self.message_ready))
        load_message.add_effect(self.message_ready, True)

        # Play message action - robot delivers the discount request
        play_message = InstantaneousAction("play_message")
        play_message.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.counter))
        play_message.add_precondition(self.message_ready)
        play_message.add_precondition(Not(self.message_played))
        play_message.add_effect(self.message_played, True)

        # Clear argument action - robot waits until argument ceases
        clear_argument = InstantaneousAction("clear_argument")
        clear_argument.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area))
        clear_argument.add_precondition(self.argument_ongoing)
        clear_argument.add_precondition(Not(self.argument_cleared))
        clear_argument.add_effect(self.argument_cleared, True)
        clear_argument.add_effect(self.argument_ongoing, False)

        return navigate_to_counter, navigate_to_waiting_area, navigate_to_storage_room, load_message, play_message, clear_argument

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "play_message": And([
                self.robot_at(self.counter),  # Robot is at counter
                self.message_ready,  # Message is ready to play
                self.cashier_at_counter,  # Cashier is present
                self.customer_at_counter,  # Customer is present
                self.argument_ongoing  # Argument is ongoing during message play
            ]),  # Playing message during argument causes psychosocial danger
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)  # Robot starts in storage room
        problem.set_initial_value(self.message_ready, False)  # Message not loaded yet
        problem.set_initial_value(self.message_played, False)  # Message not played yet
        problem.set_initial_value(self.argument_ongoing, True)  # Argument is ongoing initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.argument_cleared, False)  # Argument not cleared initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_cafe, True)  # Setting is cafe
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_speech_recognition, True)  # Robot can detect speech
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_movement_detection, True)  # Robot can detect movement
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cashier_at_counter, True)  # Cashier is at counter
        problem.set_initial_value(self.customer_at_counter, True)  # Customer is at counter

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.message_played)  # Goal: discount message has been played

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
